card.name: Inside the word glomerular
card.fires_on: The middle piece "omer" in "glomerular", right after "gl". It appears in kidney-function phrases such as glomerular filtration rate (eGFR).

modes.label: Glomerular filtration rate
modes.description: The piece "omer" inside "glomerular" before "filtration rate" or eGFR in dosing and renal-function statements.
modes.example: Do not use in patients with an estimated gl<<omer>>ular filtration rate (eGFR)

modes.label: Glomerular injury or filtration
modes.description: The same piece in "glomerular" describing kidney injury or filtration effects.
modes.example: has the potential to result in gl<<omer>>ular injury, leading to decreased kidney function

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mixed multilingual fragments, so there is no clear output effect beyond finishing the word.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of the word glomerular when the text is about kidney filtration.
